decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension and the garage conversion hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The existing parking space shown on the submited plans shall be permanently retained and shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles in connection with the use of the dwellinghouse.
Condition : 5 - The existing front boundary wall shall be permanently retained at a height of no greater than 0.6m.
Condition : 6 - The habitable room hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 28 Eton Avenue.

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed extension and alterations, due to their design, appearance and relative position to adjoining properties, would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property and the street scene, would not harm neighbours' living conditions and would not result in conditions prejudicial to highway safety. The proposal would therefore accord with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments) and the objectives of the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Demolition of exsiting canopy and erection of single storey rear extension and conversion of garage to a habitable room.
